logic_blockers.finding: A valid builder-produced hit with oversized provenance is dropped without consuming its received sequence. After observing that hit, the history accepts an older hit and then accepts the same sequence again with changed provenance.
logic_blockers.cause: The empty-pending return at lines 211-212 precedes the cursor assignment at line 214. The level binding is accepted as any nonempty string; a 1000-character Unicode binding produces a valid 3196-byte fact, exceeding the 2048-byte history budget.
logic_blockers.impact: The ordinary monotonic duplicate/older rejection guarantee does not extend across a budget-dropped valid receipt. Byte and record bounds remain intact; this is not an unbounded-memory or hostile-dataclass finding.
logic_blockers.required_contract: Dropping an oversized same-epoch newer receipt must not permit subsequently ingesting older or equal-sequence facts. Define and enforce the receipt-consumption/drop policy; no repair was performed.
